newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Saturday announced new pay scales for government officials and employees from July 1.
Port Users Forum announced a port boycott programme from June 15 to press the demand for allowing the use of private handling equipment at Chittagong Port.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Saturday said the government would constitute a full-fledged wage commission to ensure "legitimate wages" for workers.
A severe storm lashed Rajshahi and adjoining northern districts on Saturday, killing at least 11 people and injuring 250 others.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Saturday warned to unseat the government if what she said it abandoned plan to "sell out country's sovereignty".
The government is actively considering a proposal to raise prices of petroleum products by 25-30 percent.
Power Development Board on Saturday signed agreement with Wartsila Power Development of Hong Kong to set up a 100 megawatt barge-mounted electricity plant in Khulna.

A 42-member delegation from the Federation of Industries of North Eastern Region (FINER), India, arrived in Dhaka on Saturday to explore trade and economic cooperation between Bangladesh and seven north-eastern Indian states. REUTER
